Fresh public Windows lifecycle in a fully disposable HOME/USERPROFILE/APPDATA/LOCALAPPDATA/TEMP/npm cache and disposable global prefix: npm install -g @ran-sh/dsh-crew@0.3.4 from the public registry, prove generated dsh-crew.cmd is callable, then dsh-crew install -> status -> update -> status -> uninstall -> status. Public upgrade/divergence flow: in a separate disposable prefix/home install public global launcher @ran-sh/dsh-crew@0.3.3, install its managed payload, then run its dsh-crew update against live latest=0.3.4. Re-run same-version update and prove idempotence/no release-directory explosion.

Fail-closed safety: simulate candidate resolution failure and candidate validation/identity failure using disposable/local controlled inputs without mutating package-manager policy; prove the current payload, pointer, registration, and integrations remain usable and unchanged after failure.

Harness/integration health on the real installed machine: use normal product status/interfaces only, confirm DSH Crew remains installed, Harness registration is healthy, provider/model catalog is visible through Harness, Codex Desktop integration is installed, and Claude Code integration is installed. Do not inspect credential contents or normal official ~/.dsh state.

Real end-to-end execution: using the existing Crew-owned Harness profile/runtime and an already configured working provider/model selected through the Harness catalog, execute at least one real Crew workload through the installed release. Exercise multiple agent roles when available: minimum worker + reviewer, preferably flash/worker/pro/reviewer. Capture non-secret evidence of dispatch, progress/status, result delivery, agent completion, and cleanup. Verify provider/model selection comes from Harness configuration rather than Crew-specific provider secrets or hard-coded DeepSeek official API settings. If the external provider service itself is unavailable, classify ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED distinctly and do not expose credentials.

Deterministic regression: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; run focused installer/global-launcher/update/distribution/setup/runtime tests; run node --test test/*.test.mjs; pnpm run build:client and restore generated-only drift; pnpm run verify:npm-install; pnpm run verify:npm-install:official.

Source-checkout compatibility: in a separate disposable home run node scripts/setup.mjs install -> status -> uninstall and preserve the source checkout clean afterward. Confirm cross-platform path/process contract coverage in deterministic tests, but do not claim real macOS/Linux execution unless actually performed.

Final safety/state: verify no task-created worktrees/processes/prefixes/homes remain except intentionally retained test logs outside the repo, no publication/tag/Release mutation occurred, package-manager security settings were not weakened, and the real machine final state remains INSTALLED.
